681	- **R13.15 Lint before sending.** Drop any sentence of the model's that leaks urgency, a deadline, a
682	  budget, a missing alternative ("no other supplier", "single source", "line stop", "fallback"), our
683	  limit ("walk-away price", "maximum we", "best we can pay"), "total cost", "category goal" or
684	  "score"; that carries a data ID; or that states a figure found nowhere in the material. Salutation by
685	  name only if that name appears in the supplier's e-mails, else "Dear colleagues at <company>". A
686	  volume question ("which volume can you commit?") is answered by code with the number from our sheet.
687	
688	### 13.5 Never lose a reply or an accept
689	
690	- **R13.16 Reply and accept inside 60 s.** A slow POST reads the supplier's reply from the thread
691	  instead of waiting on the call, so the 60-second rule is not missed (P05 once lost two agreed deals
692	  to replies held back this way). In an RFQ a final offer that is the best on the table is accepted
693	  within 60 s of its reply, even while other threads are still talking - waiting for in-flight
694	  replies (R12.16) never runs past that clock (P05, meso3: accepted after 4.5 minutes → `409`, no deal).
695	  On a `422` for an accept (the offer moved on) reload the thread and decide again.
696	- **R13.17 Cached data layer.** Build the master data file once (`arena-build-master-data`) and cache
697	  each case's negotiation dossier per data revision, so preparation for a case is a cache hit
698	  (milliseconds) and the Sunday release is picked up automatically.
699	
700	### Not taken from the MESO agent
701	
702	- **Locking whatever the supplier picks on a heavy term**, without R13.3/R13.4 (P01, 0.159).
703	- **The fixed `(1 − concede^k)` curve as the only concession rule** - section 5 (curve, reciprocity,
704	  deadlock breaker) stays. R13.10's `concede` column is MESO's pace per goal, a reference for tuning
705	  section 5's horizon per goal.
706	
707	## Acceptance
708	
709	- Unit tests for R5.2-R5.4 (reciprocity, deadlock breaker, still-moving), R6.2-R6.5 (surplus,
710	  ask sheets, decoy, floor) and R7 (close rules, including "no close on a two-round hold").
711	- Unit tests for R11.2 (figures not in the e-mail dropped), R11.8 (prose offer locked in), R11.9-R11.11
712	  (repair, rebuild on hold, sheet guard), R11.12 (no competitive pressure without a rival), R11.14-R11.15
713	  (clock) and R11.17-R11.18 (coverage, every RFQ bidder answered).
714	- Unit tests for R12.2 (coverage lock), R12.4 (revealed slopes), R12.10 (never regress), R12.11 (accept
715	  ladder order), R12.12 (final offer accepted, one repair only), R12.14 (RFQ message 1 cites the
716	  rival) and R12.17 (model budget). TeamAgent's offline tests on recorded negotiations
717	  (`team/tests/test_offline.py`) are the template.
718	- Unit tests for R13.1-R13.5 (one term per step, option order, reopen, a step needs two packages,
719	  revealed terms), R13.6 (prose alternatives in English and German), R13.7 (no identical resend),
720	  R13.8 (equal C within EUR 1, price above the C-minimum with the margin charge), R13.9 (index window,
721	  a rising index kept out), R13.11 (volatile series), R13.15 (lint) and R13.16 (an RFQ final offer
722	  accepted inside 60 s).
723	- Practice runs, the best recorded run per case (`runs/best_runs.json`, `runs/meso3`, `runs/meso4`):
724	  P01 ≥ 0.941, P02 ≥ 0.507, P03 ≥ 0.919, P04 ≥ 0.86, P05 ≥ 0.781, P07 ≥ 0.773, P08 ≥ 0.549,
725	  P10 ≥ 0.671, P11 ≥ 0.710, P18 ≥ 0.453 (mean 71.6). The P02 best run (0.507) is in no agent's
726	  session log and is not TeamAgent's; its e-mails use the shared writer, so it is probably a BuyerAgent
727	  or DualAgent run with logging off. Treat that target as a stretch goal.
728	- All 10 practice cases end in a deal (TeamAgent v9 did).
729	- Every message goes out within 60 s; no `contradicted` claims; no e-mail without a company name;
730	  every case closed by 420 s after it opens.
731

content.text: Now the agent source, starting with the main spec agent file.

input.command: cat arena_kit/agents/spec.py

result.output:
"""SpecAgent: the buyer agent of NEW_AGENT_REQUIREMENTS.md. Code decides every number, the model
writes words only, and every model call has a code-written fallback.

  before the clock   dossiers and one profile call per supplier (section 1, `spec.dossier`)
  case open          section 0.7 (`spec.prep`): the case checked, C of every opening and C_alt,
                     coverage, levers, anchor, floor, must-have filter, the case clock
  every move         per thread: what its e-mail says (`spec.analyst`), our estimate of it (section 2),
                     the close rules (section 7, `spec.closing`), else the next offer - the target C
                     from section 5 (`spec.concession`), the sheets from MESO's steps while heavy terms
                     are open (`spec.steps`) and section 6's sheets after (`spec.sheets`), guarded -
                     and an e-mail around them (`spec.email`) in one tactic's words (`spec.tactics`)
  runner             one worker per supplier thread (`spec.runner`)

    uv run arena play case:P01 --agent spec -v
"""

import json
import logging
import math
import os
import re
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from .. import claims as cl
from .. import writing
from ..cost import cost_breakdown, must_haves_ok
from ..docs import standard_terms
from ..play import latest, live_threads, moves_left
from ..spec import clock as clock_mod
from ..spec import closing, dossier, email, levers, prep, sheets, tactics
from ..spec import estimate as est_mod
from ..spec.analyst import GRACE_S, Analyst
from ..spec.concession import Plan
from ..spec.prose import prose_alternatives
from ..spec.steps import Steps, repeats
from ..spec.terms import COVERAGE, complete, key

log = logging.getLogger("arena")
WRITE_TIMEOUT_S = 35.0  # R10.1
SEND_MARGIN_S = 4.0  # compose and send after the model answers
VOLATILE_PCT = 15.0  # R13.11
PRESSURE_LEFT = 2  # R11.8
LOCK_RISK = 0.5  # R11.8
LOCK_TOL = 0.0005


@dataclass
class Thread:
    """What we keep per supplier thread."""

    plan: Plan = field(default_factory=Plan)
    steps: Steps = field(default_factory=Steps)
    analyst: Analyst | None = None
    last_sheets: list = field(default_factory=list)  # [(label, terms)] of our last message
    flags: set = field(default_factory=set)  # earlier, repair, restore, rival, weighted, volume
    sent_claims: list = field(default_factory=list)  # the arguments of our last message, in body order
    seen_replies: int = 0
    anchor_price: float | None = None


class SpecAgent:
    def __init__(self, complete=None, package=None, analyst_complete=None, prep_complete=None, log_dir=None):
        self.complete, self.package = complete, package
        self.analyst_complete = analyst_complete if analyst_complete is not None else complete
        self.prep_complete = prep_complete if prep_complete is not None else complete
        self.log_dir = Path(log_dir or os.environ.get("SPEC_LOG_DIR", "runs/spec-logs"))
        self.case_id, self.primed = None, None
        self.reply_at, self.inflight = {}, {}  # set by the runner
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.dossiers, self.profiles, self.t = {}, {}, {}
        self.records, self._volatile = [], {}
        self.pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8, thread_name_prefix="spec")

    # --- the runner's entry -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def run_case(self, table, case_id, deadline=None):
        from ..spec.runner import play_case

        return play_case(table, case_id, self, deadline)

    # --- before the clock (section 1) ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def prime(self, case, timeout=None):
        """Dossiers and profiles before the session opens. In the final the profile budget leaves room
        for the 420 s case clock inside the wave's cap."""
        c, _ = prep.normalise(case)
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        self.dossiers = {sid: dossier.gather(self.package, c, sid) for sid in c["suppliers"]}
        if timeout is None:
            timeout = dossier.PROFILE_TIMEOUT_S
            if isinstance(c.get("seconds_left"), int | float):
                timeout = min(timeout, max(0.0, c["seconds_left"] - clock_mod.FORCE_CLOSE_AT - 30))
        self.profiles = dossier.profiles(c, self.package, self.dossiers, self.prep_complete, timeout)
        self.primed = c["case_id"]
        log.info("%s primed in %.1fs (profiles: %s)", c["case_id"], time.monotonic() - t0,
                 {s: p.get("source") for s, p in self.profiles.items()})  # fmt: skip

    # --- case open (section 0.7) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    def prepare(self, case, threads=None, seconds_left=None):
        if self.primed != case.get("case_id"):  # resumed, or no case file before the session: no model
            self.prime(case, timeout=0)
        cash = {sid: p.get("cash_short", False) for sid, p in self.profiles.items()}
        self.case = case  # hidden-case facts must be available to volatile() during preparation
        self._volatile.clear()
        self.prep = prep.prepare(case, threads, self.package, self.volatile, seconds_left, cash)
        self.case, self.case_id = self.prep.case, case.get("case_id")
        self.clock = self.prep.clock.open()
        self.ledger, self.results = cl.Ledger(), {}
        self.t = {}
        for sid in self.case["suppliers"]:
            self.t[sid] = Thread(
                analyst=Analyst(
                    self.case,
                    sid,
                    self.package,
                    self.analyst_complete,
                    self.pool,
                    cost_fn=lambda terms, std: est_mod.plain_cost(self.case, terms, std),
                )
            )
        log.info("%s", prep.summary(self.prep))
        self.record("prepare", summary=prep.summary(self.prep), warnings=self.prep.warnings)

    def volatile(self, series):
        """R13.11: the series moved more than VOLATILE_PCT in its last 12 months."""
        if series not in self._volatile:
            got = cl.index_change(self.package, getattr(self, "case", {}) or {}, series)
            if got:
                a, b = self.fact(got[1]), self.fact(got[2])
                change = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
                # Claim sentences round to a tenth; a risk threshold must not round 15.04% away.
                self._volatile[series] = abs(change) > VOLATILE_PCT + 1e-9
            else:
                self._volatile[series] = False
        return self._volatile[series]

    # --- clock hooks for the runner -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def sent(self, sid):
        if hasattr(self, "clock"):
            self.clock.sent(sid)

    def replied(self, sid):
        if hasattr(self, "clock"):
            self.clock.replied(sid)

    # --- the state of a thread ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _std(self, events):
        try:
            return standard_terms(events)
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("standard terms unreadable: %s", e)
            return {}

    def state(self, threads, sid):
        """Everything code needs about one thread now: rows, estimate, context, target, view."""
        case, events, th = self.case, threads[sid], self.t[sid]
        std = self._std(events)
        th.analyst.observe(events)
        intel = th.analyst.snapshot()
        replies = [m for m in events if m.get("from") != "buyer"]
        self._feedback(sid, events, len(replies))
        mine = " ".join(str(m.get("body") or "") for m in events if m.get("from") == "buyer").lower()
        echo = bool(re.search(r"faster payment|cash ?flow|liquidit", mine))
        cash = self.profiles.get(sid, {}).get("cash_short", False) or (intel.cash_ask and not echo)  # R11.7, R12.19
        extra = [prose_alternatives(case, m) if m.get("from") != "buyer" else [] for m in events]
        slopes = levers.revealed_slopes(case, events, extra)
        seen = [r.terms["unit_price"] for s in threads for r in self._price_rows(threads, s)]
        # the market is judged on the opening quotes only: a later concession under the should-cost must
        # not drop the margin charge mid-case (P02: 373 against a should-cost of 374.95)
        market = [p for s in threads if (p := prep.opening_terms(threads[s]).get("unit_price"))]
        est = est_mod.estimate(case, self.package, events, prep.opening_terms(events), cash,
                               levers.revealed_rate(slopes), min(market, default=None))  # fmt: skip
        c_alt = self.prep.c_alt
        rows = []
        for n, m in enumerate(replies):
            for j, ts in enumerate(m.get("term_sheets") or []):
                terms = ts.get("terms") or {}
                if not ts.get("term_sheet_id") or terms.get("unit_price") is None:
                    continue
                c = est_mod.cost(case, terms, std, est)
                plain = est_mod.plain_cost(case, terms, std)
                valid = must_haves_ok(case, terms, std) and plain < c_alt and c < c_alt
                try:
                    bd = cost_breakdown(case, terms, std)
                    unc = bd["uncovered_need"] + bd["fallback_risk"]
                except Exception:
                    unc = 0.0
                rows.append(closing.Row(ts["term_sheet_id"], terms, c, valid, n == len(replies) - 1, j == 0, n, unc))
        latest_rows = [r for r in rows if r.latest]
        best = min(latest_rows, key=lambda r: (not r.valid, r.c)) if latest_rows else None
        their = complete(case, best.terms if best else {"unit_price": None}, std)
        ctx = sheets.Ctx(case, std, est, their, self.prep.row, self.volatile)
        out = {"sid": sid, "events": events, "std": std, "intel": intel, "est": est, "rows": rows, "best": best,
               "ctx": ctx, "slopes": slopes, "alternatives": extra[-1] if extra else [], "cash_short": cash,
               "status": latest(events).get("status") if replies else None, "left": moves_left(case, events),
               "sent": sum(m.get("from") == "buyer" and not m.get("undelivered") for m in events)}  # fmt: skip
        if best is None or not their.get("unit_price"):
            out.update(target=None, info={}, base=None, locked={}, c_ref=math.inf, only_price=False)
            return out
        locked = th.steps.locked(ctx, events)
        # R13.5: actual supplier-priced alternatives supersede an earlier blind menu pick.
        locked.update(th.steps.revealed(ctx, latest(events), out["alternatives"]))
        out["locked"] = locked
        # the anchor: fixed per thread (R4.4); in an RFQ every bidder is anchored to the lowest price on the
        # table and the anchor may only fall (R4.3, R12.6)
        rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1
        seen = seen or [ctx.their_price]
        anchor_c = None
        if th.anchor_price is None or rfq:
            base0 = {k: v for k, v in sheets.repair(case, their, std).items() if k != "unit_price"}
            p0 = prep.anchor_price(case, ctx, ctx.their_price, min(seen + [ctx.their_price]), base0)
            combo = sheets.reference_combo(ctx, sheets.cover(ctx, base0, p0), ctx.their_price)
            p = prep.anchor_price(case, ctx, ctx.their_price, min(seen + [ctx.their_price]), combo)
            th.anchor_price = p if th.anchor_price is None else min(th.anchor_price, p)
            anchor_c = ctx.c({**combo, "unit_price": th.anchor_price})
        base = sheets.structure(ctx, th.anchor_price)
        base.update({f: v for f, v in locked.items() if f in base})
        ctx.locked = dict(locked)
        out["base"] = base
        c_ref = min(ctx.c({**base, "unit_price": ctx.their_price}), best.c)
        th.plan.observe(c_ref, len(replies))
        if anchor_c is not None and (th.plan.anchor is None or rfq):
            th.plan.set_anchor(min(anchor_c, c_ref), rfq)
        rival = [o.c for s, o in ((s, self._best_valid(threads, s)) for s in live_threads(threads) if s != sid) if o]
        target, info = th.plan.next_target(c_ref, self.prep.horizon, out["left"], c_alt, min(rival, default=None), rfq)
        out.update(target=target, info=info, c_ref=c_ref, rival_best=min(rival, default=None),
                   only_price=th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked) is None)  # fmt: skip
        return out

    def _price_rows(self, threads, sid):
        out = []
        for m in threads[sid]:
            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
                continue
            for ts in m.get("term_sheets") or []:
                if (ts.get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price"):
                    out.append(closing.Row(ts.get("term_sheet_id") or "", ts["terms"], 0.0, True, False))
        return out

    def _best_valid(self, threads, sid):
        std = self._std(threads[sid])
        best = None
        msg = latest(threads[sid]) if any(m.get("from") != "buyer" for m in threads[sid]) else {}
        for ts in msg.get("term_sheets") or []:
            terms = ts.get("terms") or {}
            if not terms.get("unit_price") or not must_haves_ok(self.case, terms, std):
                continue
            c = est_mod.plain_cost(self.case, terms, std)
            if c < self.prep.c_alt and (best is None or c < best.c):
                best = closing.Row(ts.get("term_sheet_id"), terms, c, True, True)
        return best

    def rival(self, threads, sid, st):
        """The rival offer to cite (R12.14): the cheapest valid rival sheet that costs us less than this
        bidder's; else the lowest rival price on the table under this bidder's price - the arena checks
        only the price (P05's 0.781 run cited offer:70240-0, whose lead time broke our must-have)."""
        mine = st["best"]
        if mine is None:
            return None
        valid = [b for s in live_threads(threads) if s != sid and (b := self._best_valid(threads, s)) and b.id]
        valid = [b for b in valid if b.c < mine.c]
        if valid:
            return min(valid, key=lambda b: b.c)
        prices = []
        for s in live_threads(threads):
            if s == sid or not any(m.get("from") != "buyer" for m in threads[s]):
                continue
            for ts in latest(threads[s]).get("term_sheets") or []:
                p = (ts.get("terms") or {}).get("unit_price")
                if ts.get("term_sheet_id") and p and p < mine.terms.get("unit_price", 0):
                    prices.append(closing.Row(ts["term_sheet_id"], ts["terms"], p, False, True))
        return min(prices, key=lambda r: r.c) if prices else None

    def _feedback(self, sid, events, n_replies):
        """R10.3: every argument's claim result, fed into the next round."""
        th = self.t[sid]
        if n_replies <= th.seen_replies:
            return
        th.seen_replies = n_replies
        for r in latest(events).get("claim_results") or []:
            i = r.get("index")
            if i is not None and i < len(th.sent_claims):
                self.results[th.sent_claims[i].key] = r.get("result")
                if r.get("result") == "contradicted":
                    log.warning("%s: argument %s was contradicted", sid, th.sent_claims[i].key)

    def view(self, st):
        th = self.t[st["sid"]]
        cs = []
        for n in sorted({r.reply for r in st["rows"]}):
            rs = [r.c for r in st["rows"] if r.reply == n]
            cs.append(min(rs))
        step_share = (cs[-2] - cs[-1]) / cs[-2] if len(cs) > 1 and cs[-2] else 0.0
        return closing.View(
            sid=st["sid"], status=st["status"], left=st["left"], sent=st["sent"], rows=st["rows"],
            target=st.get("target"), last_target=th.plan.targets[-1] if th.plan.targets else None,
            moving=bool((st.get("info") or {}).get("still_moving")), only_price=bool(st.get("only_price")),
            planned_over=len(th.plan.targets) >= self.prep.horizon + 2, close_gap=self.prep.row["close_gap"],
            replies_c=cs, earlier_used="earlier" in th.flags, repair_used="repair" in th.flags,
            restore_used="restore" in th.flags, last_step_share=step_share,
        )  # fmt: skip

    def views(self, threads):
        states = {s: self.state(threads, s) for s in live_threads(threads)}
        return states, {s: self.view(st) for s, st in states.items()}

    # --- the move ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def decide(self, case, threads, sid=None, use_model=True):
        if case.get("case_id") != self.case_id:
            self.prepare(case, threads)
        live = live_threads(threads)
        if sid is None:  # the kit's sequential loop: the thread whose offer costs least
            sid = min(live, key=lambda s: self.standing_cost(case, threads, s))
        if sid not in live:
            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
        th = self.t[sid]
        th.analyst.observe(threads[sid])
        first_rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1 and not any(m.get("from") == "buyer" for m in threads[sid])
        terminal = latest(threads[sid]).get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer")
        if use_model and self.analyst_complete is not None and not first_rfq and not terminal:
            # R11.3: a short grace; R12.14 first RFQ / R13.16 terminal offers go straight to code.
            since = time.monotonic() - self.reply_at.get(sid, time.monotonic())
            th.analyst.wait(min(GRACE_S, max(0.0, clock_mod.MODEL_WINDOW_S - since - 25)))
        with self.lock:
            states, views = self.views(threads)
            st = states[sid]
            close = closing.decide(views, sid, must_close=self.clock.must_close())
            if close is None and not self.clock.can_counter():
                close = self.late(states, views, sid)
            if close is not None:
                d = self.realise(close, states, threads, sid)
                if d is not None:
                    self.record("close", sid=sid, kind=close.kind, reason=close.reason, sheet=close.sheet_id,
                                elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1))  # fmt: skip
                    return d
            if st.get("target") is None:  # no price on the table: ask for one
                return self.plain_message(threads, sid, [], "Could you please send us your offer with a unit price?")
            move = self.plan_move(states, views, threads, sid)
            if move is None or "sheets" not in move:  # a close, an offer-back or nothing left to send
                return move or {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
        return self.write(states, threads, sid, move, use_model)

    def late(self, states, views, sid):
        """R11.16, after NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT: lock in a better prose offer if a round still fits; repeat our
        last offer only when nothing on the table is acceptable yet; otherwise close by R7."""
        fits = self.clock.round_fits()
        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
        lock = self.lock_in(st)
        best_rows = [r for v in views.values() for r in v.rows if r.valid]
        if fits and lock and (not best_rows or lock[1] < min(r.c for r in best_rows) - 0.01) and "lock" not in th.flags:
            return closing.Close("lock_in", "late: lock in its prose offer", sid, terms=lock[0])
        if fits and not closing.ladder(views) and th.last_sheets and st["left"] > 1:
            return closing.Close("repeat", "late: nothing acceptable yet - our last offer again", sid)
        return closing.accept(views, "late: no new counter-offers") or closing.Close("idle", "late, nothing yet", sid)

    def lock_in(self, st):
        """R11.8: the supplier's best offer stated only in prose, if it keeps the must-haves, beats the
        alternative and is cheaper than its standing sheet: (terms, C) or None."""
        if st.get("best") is None:
            return None
        ctx, best = st["ctx"], None
        for po in st["intel"].prose_offers:
            if po.get("in_sheet"):
                continue
            t = complete(self.case, po["terms"], st["std"])
            if not t.get("unit_price") or not ctx.ok(t):
                continue
            c = ctx.c(t)
            if c < st["best"].c - 0.01 and est_mod.plain_cost(self.case, t, st["std"]) < self.prep.c_alt:
                if best is None or c < best[1]:
                    best = (t, c)
        return best

    def realise(self, close, states, threads, sid):
        """A close rule as a decision: accept, walk, idle, or a one-off message written by code."""
        th = self.t.get(close.sid or sid)
        if close.kind == "accept":
            return {"supplier_id": close.sid, "reason": close.reason, "candidates": close.candidates,
                    "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": close.sheet_id}}}  # fmt: skip
        if close.kind == "walk":
            return {"supplier_id": close.sid or sid, "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
        if close.kind == "idle":
            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
        st = states[close.sid or sid]
        if close.kind == "offer_back":  # R12.13
            th.flags.add("earlier")
            t = complete(self.case, close.terms, st["std"])
            text = (
                f"Thank you. We have reviewed everything again and are ready to sign on your own earlier offer "
                f"{close.sheet_id} - the attached term sheet repeats exactly those terms. Can you confirm?"
            )
            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their earlier offer", t)], text)
        if close.kind in ("repair", "restore"):  # R12.12 / R11.17: its price, must-haves kept, full need covered
            th.flags.add(close.kind)
            terms = close.terms or (st["best"].terms if st.get("best") else latest(st["events"]).get("term_sheets",
                                    [{}])[0].get("terms", {}))  # fmt: skip
            t = complete(self.case, sheets.repair(self.case, terms, st["std"]), st["std"])
            t = {**t, **self.full_cover(st, t)}
            if not st["ctx"].ok(t) or t.get("unit_price") is None:
                return None
            text = (f"Thank you - we accept your price of EUR {t['unit_price']:.2f}. To complete the agreement and "
                    "cover our full requirement, please confirm it on the attached term sheet; that is all we need "
                    "to sign.")  # fmt: skip
            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("confirm", t)], text)
        if close.kind == "lock_in":
            th.flags.add("lock")
            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their prose offer", close.terms)],
                                      "Thank you - we take up the offer you described in your e-mail, as set out on "
                                      "the attached term sheet. Please confirm.")  # fmt: skip
        if close.kind == "repeat":
            return self.plain_message(
                threads, close.sid, th.last_sheets, "Thank you for your reply. Our offer stands as set out below."

    def full_cover(self, st, terms):
        """The coverage options that cover the whole need over the horizon (R12.12, R11.17)."""
        b = self.case["buyer"]
        out = {}
        for f in COVERAGE:
            opts = (self.case.get("term_options") or {}).get(f) or []
            if f not in self.case["negotiable"] or not opts:
                continue
            need = b["need_per_year"] if f == "volume_per_year" else 12 * b["horizon_years"]
            enough = [o for o in opts if isinstance(o, int | float) and o >= need - 1e-9]
            out[f] = min(enough) if enough else max(opts)
        return out

    def plan_move(self, states, views, threads, sid):
        """The sheets of our next offer: a step on the next heavy term, else a price round; guarded."""
        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
        ctx, base, target, info = st["ctx"], st["base"], st["target"], dict(st["info"])
        floor_p = sheets.floor(ctx)
        asks = self.asks(st)
        hold = info.get("kind") == "hold"
        cover_values = {f: base[f] for f in COVERAGE if f in base and f in self.case["negotiable"]}
        supplier_terms = [r.terms for r in st["rows"]]

        def guarded_build(c_target):
            out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)

            def guard_menu(menu):
                menu = sheets.lock_coverage(ctx, menu, cover_values)
                menu = sheets.guard(ctx, menu, c_target, supplier_terms, th.last_sheets)
                return sheets.no_regress(ctx, menu, [r.c for r in st["rows"] if r.valid])

            out = guard_menu(out)
            while kind == "step" and len({key(t.get(fld)) for _, t in out}) < 2:
                # The final guards can remove a choice too: record only the menu actually sent.
                th.steps.skipped.add(fld)
                out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
                out = guard_menu(out)
            return out, kind, fld

        built = guarded_build(target)
        if hold and repeats([t for _, t in built[0]], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):
            # R5.3 + R13.7: a hold that would only repeat our sheets becomes the deadlock-breaking step
            target = th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"])
            info["kind"], hold = "deadlock breaker (no repeat)", False
            built = guarded_build(target)
        out, kind, fld = built
        if (not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets])) and not hold:
            # nothing new at this target: one real step instead (R5.3) before the thread counts as done
            target = max(target, th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"]))
            info["kind"] = "deadlock breaker (nothing new)"
            out, kind, fld = guarded_build(target)
        if not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):  # R12.10 / R13.7
            v = views[sid]
            if (r := closing.earlier_cheaper(v)) is not None:
                return self.realise(closing.Close("offer_back", "nothing new to offer: its earlier offer", sid, r.id,
                                                  terms=r.terms), states, threads, sid)  # fmt: skip
            if len(views) == 1 and (acc := closing.accept(views, "nothing new to offer")):
                return self.realise(acc, states, threads, sid)  # R13.7: the thread is done - close
            if len(views) > 1:
                return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}  # RFQ: leave this thread, the others go on
            if not out:
                out = th.last_sheets or sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p) or sheets.just_under(ctx, base)
        lock = self.lock_in(st)
        pressure = st["left"] <= PRESSURE_LEFT or st["intel"].walk_risk >= LOCK_RISK or self.clock.near_end()
        if lock and (pressure or lock[1] <= target * (1 + LOCK_TOL)):
            if all((lock[0].get(f) or 0) >= v for f, v in cover_values.items() if isinstance(v, int | float)):
                out = [("their prose offer", lock[0]), *[(lb, t) for lb, t in out if t != lock[0]]]
                th.flags.add("lock")
        out = out[:3]
        return {"sheets": out, "kind": kind, "field": fld, "target": target, "info": info, "hold": hold,
                "lock": bool(lock and out and out[0][0] == "their prose offer"), "asks": asks}  # fmt: skip

        locked = st["locked"]

        while fld is not None:
            pk = th.steps.packages(ctx, fld, base, target, floor_p, asked=asks.get(fld))
            if pk:

310	    # --- the move ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
311	    def decide(self, case, threads, sid=None, use_model=True):
312	        if case.get("case_id") != self.case_id:
313	            self.prepare(case, threads)
314	        live = live_threads(threads)
315	        if sid is None:  # the kit's sequential loop: the thread whose offer costs least
316	            sid = min(live, key=lambda s: self.standing_cost(case, threads, s))
317	        if sid not in live:
318	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
319	        th = self.t[sid]
320	        th.analyst.observe(threads[sid])
321	        first_rfq = len(self.case["suppliers"]) > 1 and not any(m.get("from") == "buyer" for m in threads[sid])
322	        terminal = latest(threads[sid]).get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer")
323	        if use_model and self.analyst_complete is not None and not first_rfq and not terminal:
324	            # R11.3: a short grace; R12.14 first RFQ / R13.16 terminal offers go straight to code.
325	            since = time.monotonic() - self.reply_at.get(sid, time.monotonic())
326	            th.analyst.wait(min(GRACE_S, max(0.0, clock_mod.MODEL_WINDOW_S - since - 25)))
327	        with self.lock:
328	            states, views = self.views(threads)
329	            st = states[sid]
330	            close = closing.decide(views, sid, must_close=self.clock.must_close())
331	            if close is None and not self.clock.can_counter():
332	                close = self.late(states, views, sid)
333	            if close is not None:
334	                d = self.realise(close, states, threads, sid)
335	                if d is not None:
336	                    self.record("close", sid=sid, kind=close.kind, reason=close.reason, sheet=close.sheet_id,
337	                                elapsed=round(self.clock.elapsed(), 1))  # fmt: skip
338	                    return d
339	            if st.get("target") is None:  # no price on the table: ask for one
340	                return self.plain_message(threads, sid, [], "Could you please send us your offer with a unit price?")
341	            move = self.plan_move(states, views, threads, sid)
342	            if move is None or "sheets" not in move:  # a close, an offer-back or nothing left to send
343	                return move or {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
344	        return self.write(states, threads, sid, move, use_model)

346	    def late(self, states, views, sid):
347	        """R11.16, after NO_NEW_COUNTER_AT: lock in a better prose offer if a round still fits; repeat our
348	        last offer only when nothing on the table is acceptable yet; otherwise close by R7."""
349	        fits = self.clock.round_fits()
350	        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
351	        lock = self.lock_in(st)
352	        best_rows = [r for v in views.values() for r in v.rows if r.valid]
353	        if fits and lock and (not best_rows or lock[1] < min(r.c for r in best_rows) - 0.01) and "lock" not in th.flags:
354	            return closing.Close("lock_in", "late: lock in its prose offer", sid, terms=lock[0])
355	        if fits and not closing.ladder(views) and th.last_sheets and st["left"] > 1:
356	            return closing.Close("repeat", "late: nothing acceptable yet - our last offer again", sid)
357	        return closing.accept(views, "late: no new counter-offers") or closing.Close("idle", "late, nothing yet", sid)

359	    def lock_in(self, st):
360	        """R11.8: the supplier's best offer stated only in prose, if it keeps the must-haves, beats the
361	        alternative and is cheaper than its standing sheet: (terms, C) or None."""
362	        if st.get("best") is None:
363	            return None
364	        ctx, best = st["ctx"], None
365	        for po in st["intel"].prose_offers:
366	            if po.get("in_sheet"):
367	                continue
368	            t = complete(self.case, po["terms"], st["std"])
369	            if not t.get("unit_price") or not ctx.ok(t):
370	                continue
371	            c = ctx.c(t)
372	            if c < st["best"].c - 0.01 and est_mod.plain_cost(self.case, t, st["std"]) < self.prep.c_alt:
373	                if best is None or c < best[1]:
374	                    best = (t, c)
375	        return best

377	    def realise(self, close, states, threads, sid):
378	        """A close rule as a decision: accept, walk, idle, or a one-off message written by code."""
379	        th = self.t.get(close.sid or sid)
380	        if close.kind == "accept":
381	            return {"supplier_id": close.sid, "reason": close.reason, "candidates": close.candidates,
382	                    "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": close.sheet_id}}}  # fmt: skip
383	        if close.kind == "walk":
384	            return {"supplier_id": close.sid or sid, "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
385	        if close.kind == "idle":
386	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}
387	        st = states[close.sid or sid]
388	        if close.kind == "offer_back":  # R12.13
389	            th.flags.add("earlier")
390	            t = complete(self.case, close.terms, st["std"])
391	            text = (
392	                f"Thank you. We have reviewed everything again and are ready to sign on your own earlier offer "
393	                f"{close.sheet_id} - the attached term sheet repeats exactly those terms. Can you confirm?"
394	            )
395	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their earlier offer", t)], text)
396	        if close.kind in ("repair", "restore"):  # R12.12 / R11.17: its price, must-haves kept, full need covered
397	            th.flags.add(close.kind)
398	            terms = close.terms or (st["best"].terms if st.get("best") else latest(st["events"]).get("term_sheets",
399	                                    [{}])[0].get("terms", {}))  # fmt: skip
400	            t = complete(self.case, sheets.repair(self.case, terms, st["std"]), st["std"])
401	            t = {**t, **self.full_cover(st, t)}
402	            if not st["ctx"].ok(t) or t.get("unit_price") is None:
403	                return None
404	            text = (f"Thank you - we accept your price of EUR {t['unit_price']:.2f}. To complete the agreement and "
405	                    "cover our full requirement, please confirm it on the attached term sheet; that is all we need "
406	                    "to sign.")  # fmt: skip
407	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("confirm", t)], text)
408	        if close.kind == "lock_in":
409	            th.flags.add("lock")
410	            return self.plain_message(threads, close.sid, [("their prose offer", close.terms)],
411	                                      "Thank you - we take up the offer you described in your e-mail, as set out on "
412	                                      "the attached term sheet. Please confirm.")  # fmt: skip
413	        if close.kind == "repeat":
414	            return self.plain_message(
415	                threads, close.sid, th.last_sheets, "Thank you for your reply. Our offer stands as set out below."
416	            )
417	        return None

419	    def full_cover(self, st, terms):
420	        """The coverage options that cover the whole need over the horizon (R12.12, R11.17)."""
421	        b = self.case["buyer"]
422	        out = {}
423	        for f in COVERAGE:
424	            opts = (self.case.get("term_options") or {}).get(f) or []
425	            if f not in self.case["negotiable"] or not opts:
426	                continue
427	            need = b["need_per_year"] if f == "volume_per_year" else 12 * b["horizon_years"]
428	            enough = [o for o in opts if isinstance(o, int | float) and o >= need - 1e-9]
429	            out[f] = min(enough) if enough else max(opts)
430	        return out

432	    def plan_move(self, states, views, threads, sid):
433	        """The sheets of our next offer: a step on the next heavy term, else a price round; guarded."""
434	        st, th = states[sid], self.t[sid]
435	        ctx, base, target, info = st["ctx"], st["base"], st["target"], dict(st["info"])
436	        floor_p = sheets.floor(ctx)
437	        asks = self.asks(st)
438	        hold = info.get("kind") == "hold"
439	        cover_values = {f: base[f] for f in COVERAGE if f in base and f in self.case["negotiable"]}
440	        supplier_terms = [r.terms for r in st["rows"]]
441	
442	        def guarded_build(c_target):
443	            out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
444	
445	            def guard_menu(menu):
446	                menu = sheets.lock_coverage(ctx, menu, cover_values)
447	                menu = sheets.guard(ctx, menu, c_target, supplier_terms, th.last_sheets)
448	                return sheets.no_regress(ctx, menu, [r.c for r in st["rows"] if r.valid])
449	
450	            out = guard_menu(out)
451	            while kind == "step" and len({key(t.get(fld)) for _, t in out}) < 2:
452	                # The final guards can remove a choice too: record only the menu actually sent.
453	                th.steps.skipped.add(fld)
454	                out, kind, fld = self.build(st, base, c_target, floor_p, asks)
455	                out = guard_menu(out)
456	            return out, kind, fld
457	
458	        built = guarded_build(target)
459	        if hold and repeats([t for _, t in built[0]], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):
460	            # R5.3 + R13.7: a hold that would only repeat our sheets becomes the deadlock-breaking step
461	            target = th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"])
462	            info["kind"], hold = "deadlock breaker (no repeat)", False
463	            built = guarded_build(target)
464	        out, kind, fld = built
465	        if (not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets])) and not hold:
466	            # nothing new at this target: one real step instead (R5.3) before the thread counts as done
467	            target = max(target, th.plan.breaker(st["c_ref"]))
468	            info["kind"] = "deadlock breaker (nothing new)"
469	            out, kind, fld = guarded_build(target)
470	        if not out or repeats([t for _, t in out], [t for _, t in th.last_sheets]):  # R12.10 / R13.7
471	            v = views[sid]
472	            if (r := closing.earlier_cheaper(v)) is not None:
473	                return self.realise(closing.Close("offer_back", "nothing new to offer: its earlier offer", sid, r.id,
474	                                                  terms=r.terms), states, threads, sid)  # fmt: skip
475	            if len(views) == 1 and (acc := closing.accept(views, "nothing new to offer")):
476	                return self.realise(acc, states, threads, sid)  # R13.7: the thread is done - close
477	            if len(views) > 1:
478	                return {"supplier_id": sid, "idle": True}  # RFQ: leave this thread, the others go on
479	            if not out:
480	                out = th.last_sheets or sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p) or sheets.just_under(ctx, base)
481	        lock = self.lock_in(st)
482	        pressure = st["left"] <= PRESSURE_LEFT or st["intel"].walk_risk >= LOCK_RISK or self.clock.near_end()
483	        if lock and (pressure or lock[1] <= target * (1 + LOCK_TOL)):
484	            if all((lock[0].get(f) or 0) >= v for f, v in cover_values.items() if isinstance(v, int | float)):
485	                out = [("their prose offer", lock[0]), *[(lb, t) for lb, t in out if t != lock[0]]]
486	                th.flags.add("lock")
487	        out = out[:3]
488	        return {"sheets": out, "kind": kind, "field": fld, "target": target, "info": info, "hold": hold,
489	                "lock": bool(lock and out and out[0][0] == "their prose offer"), "asks": asks}  # fmt: skip
490	
491	    def build(self, st, base, target, floor_p, asks):
492	        th, ctx = self.t[st["sid"]], st["ctx"]
493	        locked = st["locked"]
494	        fld = th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked, list(asks))
495	        while fld is not None:
496	            pk = th.steps.packages(ctx, fld, base, target, floor_p, asked=asks.get(fld))
497	            if pk:
498	                return pk, "step", fld
499	            th.steps.skipped.add(fld)  # R13.4: no choice, no step - the term goes to the price round
500	            fld = th.steps.next_field(ctx, base, locked, list(asks))
501	        open_fields = [f for f in (th.steps.order or []) if f not in locked]
502	        profile = self.profiles.get(st["sid"], {})
503	        lv = [f for f in dict.fromkeys([*profile.get("levers", []), *self.prep.type_levers]) if f not in locked]
504	        price_asks = {f: v for f, v in asks.items() if f not in locked}
505	        out = sheets.price_sheets(ctx, base, target, lv, floor_p, open_fields, price_asks)
506	        if not th.plan.targets and out and len(out) < 3:  # R12.7: the first menu probes payment days
507	            if not any(t.get("payment_days") != out[0][1].get("payment_days") for _, t in out):
508	                if probe := sheets.payment_probe(ctx, out[0][1], target, floor_p, st["slopes"]):
509	                    out.append(("payment probe", probe))
510	        if len(out) < 3 and (iv := sheets.index_variant(ctx, out[0][1] if out else base, target, floor_p)):
511	            out.append(("their index clause", iv))  # R12.8
512	        if not out:
513	            out = sheets.out_of_reach(ctx, base, floor_p)  # R6.6
514	        return out, "price", None

516	    def asks(self, st):
517	        """R11.7: what the supplier asked for beyond our reference terms - in its sheet, or in its e-mail
518	        (the analyst's lever hints, snapped to the case's options) - when it costs us something."""
519	        ctx, base = st["ctx"], st["base"]
520	        price = ctx.their_price
521	        theirs = sheets.mutual_combo(ctx, ctx.their, price)
522	        ref = sheets.reference_combo(ctx, theirs, price)
523	        out = {f: theirs[f] for f in sheets.REFERENCE_FIELDS if f in theirs and key(theirs[f]) != key(ref.get(f))
524	               and f not in COVERAGE and f not in st["locked"]}  # fmt: skip
525	        opts = self.case.get("term_options") or {}
526	        for h in st["intel"].lever_hints:
527	            f = h.get("field")
528	            if (
529	                f in out
530	                or f not in self.case["negotiable"]
531	                or f == "unit_price"
532	                or not opts.get(f)
533	                or f in st["locked"]
534	            ):
535	                continue
536	            if not all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in opts[f]):
537	                continue
538	            nums = [float(n.replace(",", ".")) for n in re.findall(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?", h.get("hint") or "")]
539	            nums = [n for n in nums if min(opts[f]) * 0.5 <= n <= max(opts[f]) * 1.5]
540	            if nums:
541	                v = min(opts[f], key=lambda o: abs(o - nums[0]))
542	                worse = ctx.c({**base, f: v, "unit_price": price}) > ctx.c({**base, "unit_price": price})
543	                if worse and ctx.ok({**base, f: v}):
544	                    out[f] = v
545	        return out

548	    def arguments(self, states, threads, sid):
549	        """R9.5: checked arguments not cited yet, never one that came back contradicted, ranked by the
550	        profile's claim ranking, then strength."""
551	        st = states[sid]
552	        rivals = {}
553	        for s in live_threads(threads):
554	            if s != sid and (b := self._best_valid(threads, s)) and b.id:
555	                rivals[b.id] = b.terms["unit_price"]
556	        try:
557	            found = cl.candidates(self.package, self.case, sid, st["ctx"].their_price, rivals)
558	        except Exception as e:
559	            log.warning("arguments failed: %s", e)
560	            found = []
561	        keys = {a.key for a in found}
562	        found += [c for c in st["intel"].new_claims if c.key not in keys]
563	        ranking = self.profiles.get(sid, {}).get("claim_ranking") or []
564	        args = [a for a in cl.usable(found, self.ledger, sid) if self.results.get(a.key) != "contradicted"]
565	        args.sort(key=lambda a: (ranking.index(a.key) if a.key in ranking else len(ranking), -a.strength))
566	        return args

"""The published cost function: what a term sheet costs the buyer in €, plus term helpers.

C covers the buyer's fixed need over a fixed horizon: need the deal does not cover is bought at
the case's fallback price (plus the fallback risk of the category goal), committed volume is bought
needed or not, and units bought before a new price takes effect cost the current price. In
strategic and bottleneck cases a deal that leaves the supplier below a sustainable margin costs
too - pass your estimate of the supplier (`supplier_value`) to price that. Do the arithmetic here,
not in the language model.
"""

import math
import operator
from datetime import date

# Strategic and bottleneck goals: leaving the supplier below a sustainable margin costs.
RELATIONSHIP_GOALS = {"stabilise", "secure_supply"}
OPS = {
    "<=": operator.le,
    "<": operator.lt,
    ">=": operator.ge,
    ">": operator.gt,
    "==": operator.eq,
    "!=": operator.ne,
}


def closing_terms(case, terms, standard=None):
    """The terms a deal would close on: the term sheet, then the supplier's standard terms (from
    its quote PDF) for anything left out, then the case's fixed terms; gaps from the buyer's plan.
    """
    b = case["buyer"]
    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    plan = {
        "volume_per_year": b["need_per_year"],
        "contract_months": round(12 * b["horizon_years"]),
        "payment_days": b["reference_payment_days"],
        "lead_time_days": b["need_lead_time_days"],
        # an unknown Incoterm counts as the costliest: a cautious buyer does not assume DAP
        "incoterm": max(freight, key=freight.get),
    }
    t = dict(plan)
    for layer in (standard or {}, case.get("fixed_terms", {}), terms):
        t.update({k: v for k, v in layer.items() if v is not None or k not in plan})
    return t


def horizon_start(case):
    """The horizon starts at the fixed or the earliest possible effective date."""
    fixed = case.get("fixed_terms", {}).get("effective_date")
    options = [o for o in case.get("term_options", {}).get("effective_date", []) if o]
    first = fixed or (min(options) if options else None)
    return date.fromisoformat(first) if first else None


def _years(case, t):
    """Years of the horizon a deal covers; a single order (0 months) counts as one year's lot.
    A commitment beyond the horizon neither costs nor earns."""
    months = t["contract_months"]
    return min(months / 12 if months else 1.0, case["buyer"]["horizon_years"])


def _units_before(case, t, years):
    """Units bought between the horizon start and the date a new price takes effect."""
    start = horizon_start(case)
    if not t.get("effective_date") or start is None:
        return 0.0
    lag = (date.fromisoformat(t["effective_date"]) - start).days / 365
    return t["volume_per_year"] * min(max(lag, 0.0), years)


def supplier_value(case, terms, supplier):
    """What a deal is worth to the supplier per unit, in cash: the price at its standard terms that
    would pay it the same. `supplier` is your estimate of it:
      standard       its standard terms (quote PDF, `docs.standard_terms`)
      interest_rate  what money now is worth to it per year (more to a supplier short of cash)
      usual_rate     its usual cost of money (default: interest_rate); tooling paid up front is
                     worth more to it when cash is dearer than usual
      ppm            the defect rate it really achieves (default: its standard ppm commitment)
      extra          EUR per unit it gains (+) or spends (-) beyond these items, e.g. overtime for
                     a faster delivery or idle capacity a larger volume fills (default 0)
    Contract length and an index clause are security, not cash: they do not count here."""
    b, std = case["buyer"], {**supplier["standard"], **case.get("fixed_terms", {})}
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, std)
    years = _years(case, t)
    sold = t["volume_per_year"] * years
    old = _units_before(case, t, years) / sold  # sold at the current price
    rate = supplier["interest_rate"]
    pay = 1 - rate * (t["payment_days"] - std["payment_days"]) / 360
    cash_now = 1 + (rate - supplier.get("usual_rate", rate)) * years / 2
    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    ppm = supplier.get("ppm", std.get("ppm_commitment") or 0)
    return (
        t["unit_price"] * (1 - old) * pay
        + old * (b.get("current_unit_price") or 0.0) * pay
        + freight[t["incoterm"]]
        - freight[std["incoterm"]]  # it carries the freight leg
        + ((t.get("tooling_eur") or 0) - (std.get("tooling_eur") or 0)) / sold * cash_now
        - ppm / 1e6 * ((t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0) - (std.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0))
        + supplier.get("extra", 0.0)
    )


def _soft(gap):
    """Margin points below the sustainable margin, as they cost: none above it, quadratic over
    the first 5 points, linear beyond - no kink."""
    if gap <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return gap * gap / 10 if gap <= 5 else gap - 2.5


def relationship_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None, value=None):
    """Strategic and bottleneck goals only: EUR for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier
    below `sustainable_margin_pct`, per year covered. `supplier["full_cost"]` (EUR per unit) is your
    estimate of its full cost; `value` overrides `supplier_value`. Without an estimate: 0."""
    b = case["buyer"]
    per_point, sustainable = b.get("relationship_eur_per_point"), b.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
    if b.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not per_point or not sustainable or not supplier:
        return 0.0
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    worth = value if value is not None else supplier_value(case, t, supplier)
    margin = (worth - supplier["full_cost"]) / worth * 100
    return per_point * _soft(sustainable - margin) * _years(case, t)


def cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
    """C by part. `standard`: the supplier's standard terms for anything the term sheet leaves out.
    `supplier`: your estimate of the supplier for the relationship term (`supplier_value`)."""
    b, t = case["buyer"], closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    if t.get("unit_price") is None:
        raise ValueError("no unit_price: a term sheet without a price has no cost")
    years = _years(case, t)
    committed = t["volume_per_year"] * years  # bought, needed or not
    covered = min(t["volume_per_year"], b["need_per_year"]) * years
    pre = _units_before(case, t, years)
    at_new_price = (committed - pre) * t["unit_price"]
    spend = pre * (b.get("current_unit_price") or t["unit_price"]) + at_new_price
    per_defect = b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
    defect_cost = per_defect - min(t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0, per_defect)
    index = index_risk = 0.0
    if clause := t.get("index_clause"):
        path = b.get("index_paths", {}).get(clause["series"], 0.0)
        moved = max(0.0, abs(path) - clause["deadband_pct"] / 100)
        index = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * moved * math.copysign(1, path)
        index_risk = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * b.get("index_risk_pct", 0) / 100
    uncovered = (b["need_per_year"] * b["horizon_years"] - covered) * b["fallback_unit_price"]
    need = b["need_lead_time_days"]
    return {
        "price": spend,
        "uncovered_need": uncovered,
        "fallback_risk": uncovered * b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0) / 100,
        "payment_terms": spend * b["interest_rate"] * (b["reference_payment_days"] - t["payment_days"]) / 360,
        "freight": committed * b["freight_eur_per_unit"][t["incoterm"]],
        "late_delivery": b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0) * max(0, t["lead_time_days"] - need),
        "quality": committed * (t.get("ppm_commitment") or 0) / 1e6 * defect_cost,
        "tooling": t.get("tooling_eur") or 0.0,
        "index_clause": index,
        "index_risk": index_risk,
        "relationship": relationship_cost(case, t, supplier=supplier),
    }


def total_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
    """C in EUR; infinite for terms without a price (e.g. a supplier that quotes none), so such a
    sheet is never the cheapest and never beats an alternative."""
    if closing_terms(case, terms, standard).get("unit_price") is None:
        return math.inf
    return round(sum(cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard, supplier).values()), 2)


def score(c_open, c_deal, c_best):
    if c_deal is None:
        return 0.0
    if c_open - c_best <= 0.01:  # no room to negotiate: matching the best is full marks
        return 1.0 if c_deal <= c_best + 0.01 else 0.0
    return min(1.0, max(0.0, (c_open - c_deal) / (c_open - c_best)))


def must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard=None):
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []):
        value = t.get(m["field"])
        if value is None and m["op"] not in ("==", "!="):
            return False
        if not OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"]):
            return False
    return True


def snap(case, field, value):
    """The allowed value closest to `value` (case `term_options`), else `value` unchanged."""
    options = case.get("term_options", {}).get(field)
    if not options or value in options:
        return value
    if isinstance(value, int | float) and all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in options):
        return min(options, key=lambda o: (abs(o - value), o))
    return options[0]


def complete_offer(case, terms):
    """A valid term sheet: exactly the negotiable fields, gaps from the buyer's plan, snapped."""
    plan = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None})
    freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    plan["incoterm"] = min(freight, key=freight.get)  # when asking, ask for the cheapest freight
    out = {}
    for field in case["negotiable"]:
        value = terms.get(field, plan.get(field))
        if value is None and case.get("term_options", {}).get(field):
            value = case["term_options"][field][0]
        value = snap(case, field, value)
        out[field] = round(value, 2) if field == "unit_price" and value is not None else value
    return out
## Cost and score

With `N` = `need_per_year`, `H` = `horizon_years`, `V` = `volume_per_year`, `M` =
`contract_months`, `P` = `unit_price`, `r` = `interest_rate`, `d_ref` = `reference_payment_days`:

```
years     = min(M / 12, H); a single order (M = 0) counts as 1   a commitment beyond the horizon
committed = V · years                                          neither costs nor earns
covered   = min(V, N) · years
pre       = units bought between the horizon start and effective_date (at current_unit_price)
new       = (committed − pre) · P                              bought at the new price
spend     = pre · current_unit_price + new
uncovered = (N · H − covered) · fallback_unit_price
C = spend
  + uncovered · (1 + fallback_risk_pct / 100)                  uncovered need, and its risk
  + spend · r · (d_ref − payment_days) / 360                   paying earlier costs interest
  + committed · freight_eur_per_unit[incoterm]
  + late_cost_per_day · max(0, lead_time_days − need_lead_time_days)
  + committed · ppm_commitment / 1e6 · (cost_per_defect − min(chargeback_eur_per_complaint, cost_per_defect))
  + tooling_eur
  + new · material_share · max(0, |index_path| − deadband_pct / 100) · sign(index_path)   with an index clause
  + new · material_share · index_risk_pct / 100                                            with an index clause
  + relationship_eur_per_point · soft(sustainable_margin_pct − supplier_margin_pct) · years
                                                               stabilise and secure_supply only
soft(g) = 0 for g ≤ 0;  g² / 10 for 0 < g ≤ 5;  g − 2.5 for g > 5   (margin points: gentle, no kink)
```

The horizon starts at the fixed or earliest `effective_date` option; `index_path` is the case's
expected move of the clause's series.

**The supplier's margin** is `(value − full_cost) / value × 100`: `full_cost` is the supplier's
full cost per unit, `value` what the deal is worth to it in cash per unit - the price at its own
standard terms that would pay it the same: the price (units sold before the new price applies at
the current price), payment timing and tooling paid up front at what money is worth to **it** now
(more to a supplier short of cash), the freight leg it carries, chargebacks at the defect rate it
really has, and what a faster delivery, a larger volume or a tighter defect commitment costs or
brings it. A longer contract or an index clause is security for it, not cash, and does not count.
So a cash-short supplier that trades a lower price for faster payment is not squeezed.
You don't know its cost and rates - estimate them (should-cost data, its quotes, what it tells
you). `arena_kit.total_cost(case, terms, standard, supplier)` computes C, with
`arena_kit.cost.supplier_value` for your estimate of the supplier.

```
score = clip((C_open − C_deal) / (C_open − C_best), 0, 1)
```

`C_open`: the cheapest opening quote (among those that keep the must-haves). `C_best`: the cheaper
of your alternative and the best package any supplier in the case would accept with every valid
lever applied. No deal scores the alternative (0 if none); a broken must-have scores 0; if `C_open
− C_best` ≤ €0.01, a deal at `C_best` scores 1. Team total = mean case score × 100.

# AGENTS.md: Team "Promptly Done", Tacto Negotiation Arena (EHL Grand Finale 2026)

Read this first. It is the shared context for every agent (Claude Code, Codex) and every teammate.

## The challenge in short
- We build an **AI buyer agent** for Hollerau Pumpenwerke that negotiates by e-mail with Tacto's hosted
  supplier bots (https://arena.tacto.ai). Official kit, brief and API docs: `negotiation-arena-kit/`
  (vendored from github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit). Read `brief/brief.md` sections 5, 6, 7, 10.
- **Score = total cost C in EUR, not the unit price.** C includes price x volume, uncovered need at the
  fallback price, payment-days interest, freight (Incoterm), late delivery, quality (PPM, chargebacks),
  tooling, index clause, and in `stabilise`/`secure_supply` cases a charge for squeezing the supplier's
  margin. Case score = (C_open - C_deal) / (C_open - C_best), 0..1. Broken must-have = 0. No deal = alternative.
- Limits: 60 s per message, round limit per thread (default 10), 3 term sheets per message.
  Data IDs cited in e-mails are checked (`verified` helps, `contradicted` costs trust).
- **Practice quota: 200 sessions per 24 h for the whole team** (10 hosted practice cases = 10 sessions per full run).
- **Sun 08:00** new market data (`uv run arena data`). **Sun 12:00 code freeze + Live Final**: 5 waves x 8 min,
  no human in the loop, the agent must not read `/v1/events`, `/screen`, `/leaderboard`, `/results`.
  Submit on ehl.gg: repo + README + commit hash of the final agent, short description, slides.
  Top 10 pitch from 13:00 (5 min + 2 min Q&A).

## Setup
```bash
cd negotiation-arena-kit/starter-kit
cp .env.example .env        # ARENA_API_KEY (one team key), LLM_PROVIDER=openai, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, LLM_API_KEY
uv sync --all-extras
uv run arena data           # data package into data/package
uv run arena me             # quota left
```
Never commit `.env` or print keys. Entire must stay enabled (`entire enable` after cloning).
Default model `gpt-6-luna` (cheap, fast); compare with `gpt-6.1-sol` later.

## Architecture (all in `negotiation-arena-kit/starter-kit/team/`)
```
case ─► 1 PREPARE  briefing.py   supplier profile + arguments that check out (pure SQL, < 1 s)
     ─► 2 NEGOTIATE agent.py     levers.py (EUR per lever, priced at the supplier's REVEALED slopes from its
                                 own sheet pairs) → planner: fixed anchor, steps of 0/15/30/45/60 % of the C
                                 gap, full coverage locked, 2 equal-cost MESO variants (incl. a payment probe)
                                 → LLM writes the e-mail; code caps sheets to the plan's C band, completes
                                 them from OUR sheet A, drops repeated / unknown IDs. RFQ message 1: no LLM,
                                 cites the cheapest rival offer ID. LLM gets only what is left of the 60 s.
     ─► 3 CLOSE     agent.py     accept LADDER over every sheet ever offered (main + alternatives), cheapest
                                 first; final_offer = accept now (repair message only if nothing is
                                 acceptable); 'agreed' / stall -> its earlier cheaper sheet once; never send a
                                 sheet dearer than one already on the table; never break a must-have
        runner.py                one worker per supplier thread, retries + landing check on network errors,
                                 waits for in-flight rival replies before an accept, done only when the
                                 arena ended the session, closes on the ladder before a wave cap
   (supplier model: full cost = should-cost / 1.02, cash-short only from the supplier's own words)
   4 MEASURE  evaluate.py        runs cases, summary.md per run (score vs previous, missed levers, reasons)
   5 DELIVER  final.py           Live Final runner, --rehearse, --check (pre-flight)
```

Practice score (mean of 10 cases x 100, 8-min cap, `gpt-6-luna`): v2 13.3 (pushed past final offers ->
walk-aways) | v4 56.3 (accept final offers) | v5 56.7 | v6 48.6 / v7 49.5 / v8 42.4 (bugs, fixed) |
**v9 56.9, all 10 deals** | v9 with `gpt-6.1-sol` 58.1 (within noise; luna stays default). Runs vary by
about +-0.2 per case: compare versions on all 10 cases, not on one.
Weakest: P02 (copper index, firm "pricing committee"), P18/P08 (raw material: index clause + base price).

## Learned so far
Offline mining of ~80 recorded practice negotiations (Sat night, no API; rules kept only if seen in >= 3 cases):
- **Message 1 carries ~90 % of the value**: the supplier's reply to it gains +0.46 score on average, replies 2-4
  together +0.08. Put the full structure (coverage, payment variants, rival quote) into message 1.
- **The best sheet ever offered was often not taken** (P01 7/7 runs): taking it would have given 0.586 vs 0.550.
  30 % of supplier replies carry an alternative sheet, 38 % of those are cheaper for us than its main sheet.
- Any message after a `final_offer` -> walked away **8/8**; accepting it -> deal 38/38.
- 12-month packages on a 2-year need: P08 0.08 vs 0.44, P10 volume cut below the must-have 4/4.
- Suppliers charge 3-7x the value for faster lead time / chargebacks -> ask only what the need requires.
- Price-history claims "hold, but do not change our calculation" 41/46 -> context only, not an argument.
- Zero-step messages drew a final offer 37 % of the time, steps >= 15 % of the gap 17 %.
- Suppliers **walk away** when pushed after `final_offer` -> accept it.
- Pushing small levers (e.g. a chargeback worth 0.3 % of C) makes suppliers raise the price far more -> skip them.
- **Uncovered need** is bought at `fallback_unit_price`: expensive in most cases, but cheaper than the offer in
  some (P08: fallback 5.72 < offer 5.98) - the lever table knows which, trust it.
- **One full practice run at a time per team**: the key allows 10 open sessions, a second run gets HTTP 429.
  Say in the team chat before you start one. Quota is now 600 sessions per day.
- In an RFQ every thread has its own 60 s clock; calls on one session queue on the server.
- Open practice sessions count against the 10 open sessions per key -> the final runner closes them first.
- The LLM tends to concede too fast -> code caps every sheet at the planned C.

def main():
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox"])
    ap.add_argument("--sim", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=5)
    ap.add_argument("--ids", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("--no-model", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--capture-session", help="capture an existing ended session; requires exactly one --ids case")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(message)s")
    logging.getLogger("httpx").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    package = DataPackage(os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA", "data/package"))
    package.lookup("")
    server = None
    if args.sim:
        import uvicorn

        from ..sim import Sim, create_app, load_cases

        sock = socket.socket()
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{sock.getsockname()[1]}"
        state = Sim(load_cases(), package.facts)
        server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(state), log_level="error"))
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={"sockets": [sock]}, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        while not server.started:
            time.sleep(.01)
        client = ArenaClient(url, rate=9)
        key = client.register("SpecAgent rehearsal", "sim")["api_key"]
        client = ArenaClient(url, key)
    else:
        client = ArenaClient()
        print(json.dumps({"quota": client.me().get("practice")}), flush=True)
    try:
        cases = hosted(client.cases(args.set))
        if args.ids:
            ids = {i if i.startswith("case:") else f"case:{i}" for i in args.ids}
            cases = [c for c in cases if c["case_id"] in ids]
            if {c["case_id"] for c in cases} != ids:
                raise ValueError("one or more requested cases are unavailable")
        if args.capture_session:
            if len(cases) != 1:
                raise ValueError("capture requires exactly one case")
            case = cases[0]
            state = client.session(args.capture_session)
            if state.get("case_id") != case["case_id"] or state.get("status") != "ended":
                raise ValueError("capture session must be ended and match the requested case")
            threads = {sid: client.thread(args.capture_session, sid) for sid in case["suppliers"]}
            args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            record = {"case_id": case["case_id"], "session_id": args.capture_session, "session": state,
                      "result": state.get("result"), "threads": threads,
                      "audit": audit(threads)}
            write_json(args.out / f"{case['case_id'].split(':')[-1]}.json", record)
        else:
            evaluate(client, cases, args.out, package, args.parallel, args.no_model)
    finally:
        if server:
            server.should_exit = True


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

**What changed (all uncommitted, 209 tests pass, ruff clean):**
- **Supplier cost estimate** ([estimate.py](arena_kit/spec/estimate.py)): the should-cost is now discarded only when should-cost ÷ 1.02 sits at or above the lowest quote. Before, P02's estimate dropped to 337 against a real cost of about 367, and the agent pushed until the supplier walked.
- **Opening anchor** ([prep.py](arena_kit/spec/prep.py)): anchors can now go down to 0.98 × the estimated full cost, not 1.01 ×, which had left P02 no room at all.
- **90-day payment in the first menu** ([pricing.py](arena_kit/spec/pricing.py), [steps.py](arena_kit/spec/steps.py)): the payment menu now keeps a payment term whose cheapest cost lands within 0.4% of the target, so 90 days stays in. This mainly affects P02 and P03.
- **Payment priced on the supplier's own rate** ([steps.py](arena_kit/spec/steps.py)): when a supplier prices two payment terms itself, every other payment option is priced on that rate. In P03 this puts 90 days at 432.28, the best run's deal.
- **Index clauses** ([sheets.py](arena_kit/spec/sheets.py), [steps.py](arena_kit/spec/steps.py)): when the supplier insists on an index clause, the menu offers its series at different deadbands instead of "no clause", and doesn't reopen it. That reopen wasted rounds in P08 and P18. The no-reopen change came after v2 started, so v2 didn't test it.
- **Accepting before a walk-away** ([closing.py](arena_kit/spec/closing.py), [analyst.py](arena_kit/spec/analyst.py)): the agent accepts the best offer on the table when a supplier says it has no room left and is only moving a little. It also accepts when the supplier asks to close and is within 2% of our target.
- **No more token steps** ([concession.py](arena_kit/spec/concession.py)): when the supplier moves further than the remaining gap, we meet it halfway. In P05 a 4-cent reply to a €2.50 drop made the best bidder withdraw.

**Results so far:** the v1 sweep (first three changes plus the walk-away rule) averaged **61.9**, against 60.1 and 62.2 for the two earlier runs of this code. Single sweeps swing by about ±0.2 per case, so one sweep can't establish a gain yet.
